newsitem.title: TURKEY: SOCCER-FENERBAHCE FAN DIES IN ROOF FALL.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-FENERBAHCE FAN DIES IN ROOF FALL.

text.p: A Turkish fan fell to his death as he tried to adjust a television aerial for a perfect picture of Wednesday's European Champions' League match between Fenerbahce and Manchester United.
Nejdet Yavuzer, 38, was killed when he fell from the roof of the five-storey apartment in the eastern town of Erzurum, the state-run Anatolian news agency said on Thursday.
Soccer-related deaths are not uncommon in Turkey. Heart attacks brought on by the excitement of big derby games and stray bullets fired by celebrating fans have taken their toll.
Last year, two people hanged themselves after their team narrowly lost a match. Post-match fights with knives and sticks have also claimed lives.
